title: 12日間 Island Explorer （4つ星ホテル＆専用車）
seoTitle: 12日間 Island Explorer （4つ星ホテル＆専用車） | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private 12日間 Sri Lanka tour: Wilpattu safari, Sigiriya, Trincomalee whales, Kandy, tea country, Ella, Galle, and Kalutara.
shortDescription: Wilpattu, east coast, highlands, and south in twelve days - 4 STAR hotels and 専用車 throughout.
overview:
An eleven-night private exploration from Wilpattu and the Cultural Triangle to Trincomalee's east coast for dolphin and whale watching, scuba, and snorkeling.
Return inland via Dambulla and Kandy, rise into tea country and Ella, then finish through Galle, turtle hatcheries, and Bentota before a Colombo city tour and airport departure — wildlife, culture, east coast, and south coast in one unhurried circuit.

seo.metaTitle: 12日間 Island Explorer （4つ星ホテル＆専用車） | Hai Sri Lanka
seo.metaDescription: Private 12日間 Sri Lanka tour: Wilpattu safari, Sigiriya, Trincomalee whales, Kandy, tea country, Ella, Galle, and Kalutara.

itinerary.title: Airport / Hotel – Wilpattu
itinerary.description: Travel north to Wilpattu for a safari in one of Sri Lanka’s oldest and wildest national parks, then overnight near Wilpattu or Anuradhapura.

itinerary.title: Wilpattu – Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Continue to Sigiriya to climb Lion Rock, enjoy a village tour, and unwind with an Ayurveda massage.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Climb Pidurangala for sunrise or panoramic views, then an elephant safari at Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco Park.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya – Trincomalee
itinerary.description: Cross to the east coast for Koneswaram Hindu Temple and Lover’s Leap viewpoints above the Indian Ocean.

itinerary.title: Trincomalee
itinerary.description: A full east-coast day for dolphin and whale watching, scuba diving, and snorkeling in clear waters.

itinerary.title: Trincomalee – Kandy
itinerary.description: Return inland via Dambulla Cave Temple and Matale Spice Garden, then a gem museum, Upper Lake Drive, and Kandyan cultural dance.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Morning at the Temple of the Tooth Relic, then climb into the tea hills with Ambuluwawa Tower, a plantation and factory visit, and a Nuwara Eliya city tour.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya – Ella
itinerary.description: Early trek in Horton Plains National Park, then continue to Ella by scenic train through the hills.

itinerary.title: Ella
itinerary.description: A relaxed Ella day — city tour in the morning, then free time to unwind in the hills.

itinerary.title: Ella – Galle
itinerary.description: Descend toward the south coast with a stop at Ravana Falls, then explore historic Galle Fort.

itinerary.title: Galle – Kalutara
itinerary.description: Visit a turtle hatchery and enjoy a Bentota boat ride before overnighting in Kalutara.

itinerary.title: Kalutara – Airport
itinerary.description: A Colombo city tour timed to your schedule, then private drop-off to the airport.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes. We tailor pace, hotels, and experiences — including safari parks and marine activities — to your preferences.

faqs.question: Is whale watching seasonal?
faqs.answer: Trincomalee whale and dolphin watching is typically best from May to October. Outside peak season we suggest snorkeling, diving, or other coastal alternatives.
